name: apimachinery-lossless-wire-image-round-trips
instr:
Kubernetes apimachinery cannot preserve unknown wire content when typed runtime objects are decoded, changed, and re-encoded. Add an opt-in path faithful to the source format through recognition, Scheme creation, conversion, and codec negotiation. Do not change existing codec behavior.

Preserving decode must return the resolved GVK and an immutable, format-aware `WireSnapshot` bound to the visible object, whether supplied into, Scheme-created, defaulted, or converted. Follow Scheme creation and supplied-into rules for snapshot GVK and object identity. Missing-kind, unregistered-kind, and incompatible-object inputs must retain their distinct failures and return no usable snapshot.

During reconciliation, typed mutations win conflicts, deleted known fields stay deleted, and unknown content survives. Reject incompatibility before writing output with `ErrSnapshotObjectMismatch` (`wire snapshot belongs to another object`), `ErrSnapshotFormatMismatch` (`wire snapshot media type is incompatible`), or `ErrSnapshotGVKMismatch` (`wire snapshot GVK is incompatible`).

Preserve native unknown structures, scalar values, tags, envelopes, framing, raw behavior, allocator behavior, strict diagnostics, pretty output, and unstructured-list semantics for JSON, YAML, protobuf, and CBOR. Recognition must return only the accepting decoder's snapshot, including on fallback paths. Aggregate and malformed-input failures return no usable snapshot. Versioning must reconcile against the visible target
